industry.key: P. Energy, commodities and metals mining
industry.why: Neutral, carried; the condition back to B (industry relative strength returning to B with oil holding) is not met: relative strength C (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; A prior), Brent near $90 (Goldman, Struyven, 22-Nov) from $111 to $115 at the October reads. The sector rows carry the view (Downstream A, Upstream B, Services B) and each is $5 from its $85 trigger, with Goldman's base case ($88 average in 2027, $78 by December 2027) going through it and Kofler (Jefferies, 21-Nov) fearing Iran escalation the other way. 18 Pool names. Back to B if relative strength returns to B with Brent holding above $85.

sector.why: Double Overweight, carried; the condition (back to B if the refining margin falls below $40 a barrel or Brent below $85) is tested on Brent alone and has not fired: Brent near $90 (Goldman, Struyven, 22-Nov), with Goldman's base case ($88 average in 2027, $78 by December 2027) going through the trigger within the year and Kofler (Jefferies, 21-Nov) fearing Iran escalation the other way. Refining and distribution benefit from disruption whatever the oil price does next. Relative strength A (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; A prior). Pool names HELLENiQ Energy (five of eight at A or B), Motor Oil, Hafnia, TORM, BW LPG. Counter-case: a top letter five dollars from its trigger with the consensus path pointing through it. Back to B if Brent is read under $85 or the refining margin under $40.

geography.why: Double Underweight, carried, now on fresh evidence rather than the stale spread: France's forward-looking PMI fell to 46.2 to 46.8, near its record low, 'a deepening downturn' (S&P Global via Pivotus, 23-Nov; Goldman Economics, 24-Nov), Pivotus calls it 'a disaster', Macron is considering a constitutional 'golden rule' if markets stay unstable in January with Le Pen leading the polls (Pivotus, 23-Nov), and Stehn (Goldman, 22-Nov) expects France to stagnate until its elections. The premium in basis points was unread for a fourth week, so last week's staleness rule (to D if unread again) is overtaken by the political and activity evidence, said plainly. 15 Pool stocks are French-listed, most of them global businesses. Counter-case: a top letter on a country whose listed companies earn mostly abroad, and the mid-2027 election is far away. To D when the premium is read under 120 basis points for a month with the PMI off its low; to C under 100.
